quick_skim.title: GeoSPRINT: Geometric Redundancy-Aware Step Pruning for Inference in Diffusion Trajectories
quick_skim.abstract: Diffusion models achieve high sample quality but remain expensive at inference time because sampling requires many sequential neural function evaluations (NFEs). Existing acceleration methods either use fixed step-skipping schedules, adapt step sizes based on local numerical error, or require additional training. We introduce GeoSPRINT (Geometric Step Pruning for Inference in Trajectories), a training-free framework for constructing non-uniform sampling schedules from the geometry of denoising trajectories. GeoSPRINT detects geometrically redundant steps using a hyperplanarity test in latent space, implemented efficiently via QR factorization, and converts the resulting redundancy profile into a sampling schedule that allocates more steps to high-curvature regions of the trajectory. In addition, we introduce the trajectory projection score $α_{\mathrm{traj}}$, a residual-variance metric that quantifies trajectory straightness and serves as a model-free diagnostic for rectified flow quality. Across CIFAR-10 ($32{\times}32$), LSUN Church ($256{\times}256$), and Stable Diffusion v1.5 ($512{\times}512$ latent), GeoSPRINT consistently improves over uniform DDIM (Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models) schedules at matched NFE budgets. On CIFAR-10, GeoSPRINT improves FID (Fréchet Inception Distance) by 0.7-1.1 over DDIM across 49-89 NFEs and surpasses DPM-Solver++ at NFE${\geq}30$ despite using a first-order DDIM solver. On LSUN Church, it reduces FID from 1.48 to 1.26 at 52 steps, and on Stable Diffusion v1.5 it achieves up to 1.93 FID improvement over DDIM. These results show that trajectory geometry provides a useful global signal for allocating inference steps and that schedule quality can substantially improve diffusion sampling efficiency without retraining.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: A training-free framework that prunes geometrically redundant denoising steps by testing trajectory hyperplanarity with QR factorization, yielding non-uniform schedules to reduce sequential NFEs in diffusion sampling
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 扩散模型采样质量高，但推理时需要大量顺序网络函数评估；现有加速方法或采用固定跳步、依据局部数值误差剪步，或需额外训练。GeoSPRINT提出免训练框架，在潜空间用超平面性测试和QR分解检测去噪轨迹中几何冗余的步骤，并将冗余分布转换为非均匀采样计划。该方法无需微调即可减少顺序采样步数，为扩散模型高效推理提供通用加速，并可用于流体仿真等科学生成任务。

quick_skim.title: Learning Informative Prior with Infinite-Dimensional Continuous Normalizing Flow for Bayesian Inverse Problem
quick_skim.abstract: This paper addresses infinite-dimensional Bayesian inference for inverse problem of partial differential equations with model parameters in infinite-dimensional Hilbert space. To effectively incorporate prior information, we propose a novel continuous normalizing flows based infinite-dimensional model. Specifically, by introducing a well-defined neural ordinary differential equation in infinite-dimensional space, a simple reference measure can be transformed into a more complex measure which encodes the prior information. A corresponding theoretical framework is established to ensure the well-posedness of our proposed Bayesian prior in infinite-dimensional space. We also provide training methods of the prior for two distinct data settings, along with two sampling algorithms for the resulting Bayesian posterior. The proposed framework is applied to three representative inverse problems: the simple smooth inverse problem, inverse scattering problem, and the inverse heat conduction problem. Numerical experiments support the theoretical analysis and demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed algorithms.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: An infinite-dimensional continuous normalizing flow prior is proposed for Bayesian inverse PDE problems: a well-posed neural ODE in Hilbert space transforms a simple reference into an informative measure, with theory and training, enabling generative parameter-field estimation useful for fluid dynamics.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对偏微分方程模型参数反演中先验难以融入无限维函数空间的问题，论文提出基于连续归一化流的无限维贝叶斯先验建模方法。该方法在无限维希尔伯特空间定义神经常微分方程，将简单参考测度变换为可编码复杂先验信息的测度，并建立良定义性理论框架与训练算法。这套框架使模型参数在无穷维空间中的反演能利用生成式流先验，为求解PDE约束的贝叶斯逆问题提供了有理论保证的建模路径，也可推广至流体动力学参数估计。
